rounds.text: A calm banking palette should feel steady and trustworthy, so I've built it around a deep, muted navy-blue for primary actions and a soft slate for secondary elements. A gentle teal accent marks positive states like deposits and completed transfers. Each text pairing is checked for contrast against its background, and the primary blue stays dark enough for white button labels.
